description: Plan finish machining of cast housings with RFQ guidance on blank condition, machining allowance, bearing bores and sealing faces.
main:
Capabilities
/
Casting machining
Finished interfaces for cast components

Machining cast housings, transmission components and pump bodies. Send the casting specification along with the finished-part drawing.

Prepare RFQ email
Transmission housings & pump bodies
Finish machining for cast blanks

The casting and finished-part drawings must show what remains as cast and where material is removed. Confirm blank supply and acceptance before planning the machining work.

Geometry & process
For adding finished bores, mounting faces, threads and passages to cast blanks. Milling, boring, drilling and tapping address transmission housings, pump bodies and structural enclosures. Reverse engineering support includes sample scanning, 2D/3D model reconstruction and manufacturability review.
Size & workholding
Share the blank model or photos, overall dimensions and casting and finished-part drawings. Fixtures for irregular blanks use casting datums, stock allowance and accessible clamping positions. Identify who supplies and approves the casting.
Material & finish
Specify the casting alloy and condition. Distinguish as-cast surfaces from machined faces and identify the required finish on the finished interfaces. These machining examples do not establish an in-house foundry service.
Turn a cast blank into controlled interfaces
More part examples
Browse all parts
Cast housings & structural enclosures
CNC-machined casting housings
Drawing & acceptance
Drawing requirements

Distinguish as-cast surfaces from machined faces. Supply casting and finished-part drawings with machining allowance and datum targets.

Identify bearing bores, seal lands and mounting interfaces whose alignment depends on the blank and fixture locations.

Inspection and acceptance

Agree incoming-blank acceptance, material documentation and dimensional checks on the finished interfaces.

Specify any porosity, pressure-integrity or non-destructive examination separately. Agree who is responsible and the acceptance criteria.

Agree the measurement method and required records before production.

Quality & inspection
Equipment and order records
Prepare your casting machining enquiry

Share blank photos or models, alloy and condition, available stock allowance and the number of castings available.

Identify responsibility for casting supply, rejected blanks and any sample-based reconstruction; a photo is insufficient to define internal geometry.

Prepare RFQ email

Add your requirements to the email draft, then attach drawings in your email app before sending.
